svg.title: Karachi — The City of Lights
svg.desc: An isometric Karachi night skyline built from GitHub contributions, 29 Nov 2025 → 28 Nov 2026: a 53-by-7 grid laid out like the contribution graph, one building per day, taller and brighter on busier days. 451 contributions on 70 days; brightest day 17 October 2026 with 68.
svg.text: my GitHub year, built in 3D · one building per day, a lit window for every day I shipped code
dark → brightest · weeks run left → right, Sunday at the back, Saturday on the seafront · 29 Nov 2025 → 28 Nov 2026
